states: Matched production-mode Chromium 141.0.7390.37 / Playwright 1.56.1; desktop light and touch phone dark. 746 browser assertions and sixteen inspected before/after captures.

Add from metadata URL and Edit from saved XML show an unread-signing-cert warning without obscuring metadata read or sign-in not tested. The detailed result keeps the identity, SSO URL and next check. At narrow width, the full dialog title, Test/Preview, metadata URL guidance and footer stay in view.
A current certificate, mixed current/expired certificates, a manual URL-format check, and incomplete metadata keep distinct existing outcomes. Read-only inventory cannot add or edit.
interactions: Run Test once per fixture; compare the exact payload and serve the captured offline handler response. Use Enter or touch to navigate from the sticky result to its details; dismiss back to Test and clear old results when the tested input changes.
Check Save/Create and Cancel remain in view and the diagnostic does not disable Save. No saves, real provider requests or sign-in attempts.
